variablesInModel.Name: departure time
variablesInModel.Description: Actual departure time of train service k_p at platform p (Table 3 decision variable). Continuous: Sect. 4.2 lists y, l, xi, gamma, eta as the only integer variables.

variablesInModel.Name: arrival time
variablesInModel.Description: Arrival time of train service k_p at platform p (Table 3 decision variable). Continuous (not among the integer variables listed in Sect. 4.2).

variablesInModel.Name: number of train units
variablesInModel.Description: Number of train units composing train service k_p at platform p (Table 3 decision variable), declared \ell_p(k_p) \in Z_+.

variablesInModel.Name: train-unit availability (ordering) indicator
variablesInModel.Description: Binary (Table 3): 1 if train units of service k_{p'} at platform p' can be reused for service k_p at platform p of the same depot; defined by (14), linearized by (29).

variablesInModel.Name: composition-change indicator
variablesInModel.Description: Binary (Table 3): 1 if the composition of service k_p is changed at platform p; defined by (11) as |y_p(k_p)| > 0, linearized by (27)-(28).

variablesInModel.Name: dwell time
variablesInModel.Description: Dwell time of train service k_p at platform p. Judgement: Table 4 calls it an output variable; output variables are unknowns of problem (26)/(30) (counted in Table 5), so they are annotated as variables. Continuous.

variablesInModel.Name: headway
variablesInModel.Description: Departure-arrival headway between services k_p and k_p+1 at platform p (Table 4 output variable, an unknown of problem (26)/(30), not given data). Continuous.

variablesInModel.Name: running time
variablesInModel.Description: Running time of service k_p from platform p to its successor s^{pla}(p) (Table 4 output variable, an unknown of problem (26)/(30), not given data). Continuous.

variablesInModel.Name: turnaround time
variablesInModel.Description: Turnaround time of service k_p at terminal platform p (Table 4 output variable, an unknown of problem (26)/(30), not given data). Continuous.

variablesInModel.Name: additional dwell time for a composition change
variablesInModel.Description: Additional time for changing the composition of service k_p at platform p, set by (13) (Table 4 output variable, an unknown of problem (26)/(30), not given data). Continuous.

variablesInModel.Name: train units to/from the depot
variablesInModel.Description: Train units coming from (>0) or returning to (<0) the depot for service k_p at platform p (Table 4); declared y_p(k_p) in Z and named an integer variable in Sect. 4.2.

variablesInModel.Name: passengers waiting at the predetermined departure
variablesInModel.Description: Passengers waiting at platform p just before d^{pre}_p(k_p) (Table 4). Judgement: a queue state, but its values over the horizon are predicted by (16) and are unknowns; only the measured initial state is given. Continuous.

variablesInModel.Name: transfer passengers
variablesInModel.Description: Transfer passengers arriving at platform p for service k_p, set by (21) (Table 4 output variable, an unknown of problem (26)/(30), not given data). Continuous.

variablesInModel.Name: departing passengers
variablesInModel.Description: Passengers departing from platform p with service k_p, bounded by (18a)-(18b) (Table 4 output variable, an unknown of problem (26)/(30), not given data). Continuous.

variablesInModel.Name: arriving passengers
variablesInModel.Description: Passengers arriving at platform p with service k_p from the predecessor platform p^{pla}(p), set by (20) (Table 4 output variable, an unknown of problem (26)/(30), not given data). Continuous.

variablesInModel.Name: passengers waiting before departure
variablesInModel.Description: Passengers waiting at platform p immediately before the departure of service k_p, set by (17) (Table 4 output variable, an unknown of problem (26)/(30), not given data). Continuous.

variablesInModel.Name: capacity of the train service
variablesInModel.Description: Total capacity of service k_p at platform p, C_p(k_p) = \ell_p(k_p) C_{max} by (19) (Table 4). Domain not declared; Judgement: continuous (not among the integer variables of Sect. 4.2).

variablesInModel.Name: passengers waiting after departure
variablesInModel.Description: Passengers left waiting at platform p immediately after service k_p departs, set by (23) (Table 4 output variable, an unknown of problem (26)/(30), not given data). Continuous.

variablesInModel.Name: absolute value of y (auxiliary)
variablesInModel.Description: Auxiliary continuous variable of Transformation property 4.1 with o_{k_p,p} = |y_p(k_p)|, enforced by (27).

variablesInModel.Name: sign indicator of y (auxiliary)
variablesInModel.Description: Auxiliary binary variable of Transformation property 4.1: 1 if o_{k_p,p} = y_p(k_p), 0 if o_{k_p,p} = -y_p(k_p); it appears only in (27).

objective_functions.Name: (26) with (31) and (25): weighted passenger delay and operational cost
objective_functions.description: Judgement: one weighted-sum objective, (26) with the nonlinear (24) replaced by its linear approximation (31) (Sect. 4.3) and (25) substituted; w_1, w_2, w_3 (32) and d^{pre} are parameters, the J terms are not variables.

constraints.Name: (1) departure time window, one departure per cycle
constraints.description: No early departure and exactly one departure per cycle. Judgement: the bounds are timetable parameters, so this is kept as a constraint, not a domain declaration; strict < as written.

constraints.Name: (2) departure equals arrival plus dwell
constraints.description: Departure time of service k_p at platform p equals its arrival time plus its dwell time.

constraints.Name: (3) headway
constraints.description: The next service arrives at platform p one headway h_p(k_p) after the departure of service k_p.

constraints.Name: (4) minimum headway
constraints.description: Safety headway. A bound by a parameter (h^{min}_p), kept as a numbered constraint: it is not a pure domain declaration.

constraints.Name: (5) arrival at the successor platform
constraints.description: Arrival of service k_p at the successor platform s^{pla}(p) equals its departure at p plus the running time.

constraints.Name: (6) running time bounds
constraints.description: Running time between its minimum and maximum; parameter bounds, kept as a numbered constraint.

constraints.Name: (7) turnaround at the terminal
constraints.description: Turnaround at the terminal station: the continuing service k_{s^{pla}(p)} arrives at the successor platform one turnaround time after service k_p departs from p.

constraints.Name: (8) turnaround time bounds
constraints.description: Turnaround time between its minimum and maximum; parameter bounds, kept as a numbered constraint.

constraints.Name: (9) train composition update
constraints.description: Units on service k_p equal those from the predecessor platform plus the units added from or returned to the depot where adjustment is allowed (sigma_p is a 0/1 parameter).

constraints.Name: (10) train length bounds
constraints.description: Minimum and maximum number of train units per service; parameter bounds, kept as a numbered constraint.

constraints.Name: (12) minimum dwell time
constraints.description: Dwell time covers the minimum dwell time plus the extra time for a composition change (sigma_p is a parameter).

constraints.Name: (13) additional dwell time for a composition change
constraints.description: The additional dwell time is t^{comp}_p when the composition changes; a binary variable times a parameter, so linear.

constraints.Name: (15) rolling-stock circulation, depot inventory
constraints.equation: \sum_{k'_p\in I_p(k_p)} y_p(k'_p) + \sum_{p'\in dep(z)\setminus\{p\}}\sum_{k_{p'}\in I_{p'}} \xi_{k_p,k_{p'},p,p'} y_{p'}(k_{p'}) \le N^{train}_z
constraints.description: Depot inventory stays feasible. Judgement: as written the binary variable xi multiplies the integer variable y (bilinear); the paper calls the Sect. 4.3 model an MILP but states no linearization of this product, so Linear=false.

constraints.Name: (16) passenger queue update
constraints.description: Queue at the next predetermined departure: passengers carried over plus arrivals (a parameter term) plus transfers minus departures.

constraints.Name: (17) passengers waiting before departure
constraints.description: Passengers waiting at the actual departure. The arrival rate rho is a parameter, so the term in d_p(k_p) is linear.

constraints.Name: (18a) boarding limited by waiting passengers
constraints.description: Judgement: (18a) and (18b) carry separate tags and are counted as two constraints; together they are the paper's linear approximation of n^{depart} = min{n^{before}, C}.

constraints.Name: (18b) boarding limited by capacity
constraints.description: Departing passengers do not exceed the capacity of the service (second half of (18)).

constraints.Name: (19) capacity of the train service
constraints.description: Capacity equals the number of train units times the unit capacity C_{max} (a parameter).

constraints.Name: (20) passengers arriving from the predecessor platform
constraints.description: Passengers arriving at platform p with service k_p equal those departing from the predecessor platform.

constraints.Name: (21) transfer passengers
constraints.description: Transfers from the other platforms of the station. chi (binary parameter fixed by the timetable via (22)) and beta are parameters, so linear.

constraints.Name: (23) passengers waiting after departure
constraints.description: Passengers left behind by service k_p.

constraints.Name: (27) absolute value of y (Transformation property 4.1)
constraints.description: Big-M system making o = |y|; with (28) it replaces the if-then definition (11) in the MILP. One numbered system of four inequalities, counted once.

constraints.Name: (28) composition-change indicator (Transformation property 4.2)
constraints.description: eta = 1 if and only if o > 0; with (27) it replaces (11). One numbered system of two inequalities, counted once.

constraints.Name: (29) train-unit availability indicator (Transformation property 4.3)
constraints.description: Replaces (14). Judgement: as written it uses arrival times a (not d, no t^{roll} as in (14)) and xi multiplies a_p(k_p) in both lines: bilinear as written, so Linear=false despite the paper's MILP claim.
